title: Probe the student's reasoning
section: A guiding question about the observed mistake
text: For a hint or a misconception, ask one concrete question about the student's current reasoning. Use the failing input and the exact return or condition. Give the student room to identify the mismatch before showing a correction.
basis: MathDial train record qid=5000012, scenario=1. Teacher turns carry probing labels and address a described confusion.
status: Draft coding adaptation. No instructor review or measured transfer benefit.

title: Give one hint at a time
text: In hint mode, start with the relevant condition or control flow. When the student asks for more help, make the clue more specific. Explain or debug mode may show a minimal correction. Do not give a full solution as the first hint.
basis: OATutor content bundle a0098c7realnumbers10: hint objects carry IDs, types, and dependencies between hints.
status: Draft coding adaptation. No instructor review or measured transfer benefit.

title: Check the idea on another input
section: A new case after the explanation
text: After an explanation or debug correction, ask the student to predict a different input. An empty array, a target at the last index, or a repeated target can check whether the idea transfers. A passing program does not establish student mastery.
basis: Original project design proposal. This card does not derive from a measured dataset outcome.
